jobs.tierReason: auto-approval policy for hand-build windows and git push; a bypass lets a session push or rewrite the repo unattended
jobs.prompt: Static security review of coordination/review/aa-new.diff (auto-approve windows: tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs and its hooks in tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/handbuild-guard.mjs, tools/self-approval.mjs). Promises: only swarm/* or feat/* branches; push only to origin (the project's own repository URL) of the current branch to the same-named remote branch, never main or protected branches, no force, delete or refspec tricks; no bare git push or config overrides; the approval is bound to branch name and HEAD at grant and re-checked at execution; git switch only to allowed-prefix branches on a clean tree, no checkout with paths or force; no worktree remove --force or prune; no commit --amend, -C, -c, --no-verify; per-window and per-day caps fall back to the owner; the stats and log files are protected from session writes and every auto-approval is logged; orchestrator mode gains no commit, push or switch ability. The previous review of the old branch failed on: push to any remote, bare push/upstream config, branch race, switch/checkout paths and dirty carry, worktree remove --force, --amend/-C, no cumulative limit, unprotected stats/log. Check each is fixed and look for NEW bypasses (command wrappers, environment variables like GIT_DIR or GIT_SSH_COMMAND, aliases, hooks, symlinks, a second remote added by git remote add, URL rewrite config, case or path tricks). No working exploit commands: class and fix. Verdict PASS or FAIL, ranked findings.
